title: 青岚风云 第5章 九转玄元功藏经阁捡漏上古功法青岚风云 第6章 三日破六层吊打炼气七层田尘
slug: 凡人修仙我能无限重生
content_zh:
藏经阁。
共三层，位于宗门山顶，一层是黄阶功法，二层是玄阶，三层是地阶，只有内门以上弟子才能进入。
“林师侄，内门弟子只能在第一层任选一本黄阶中品功法，或两部黄阶下品功法，我就不陪你进去了，你自己进去挑选吧！”李长老说完，便在阁外等候。
林越点了点头，走了进去，
管理藏经阁的是一个白发老头，他好奇地看了林越一眼，“新来的内门弟子？你就是青阳城四系伪灵根林越吧！”
“晚辈，正是。”林越抱拳。
“你想问我是为什么认识你，对不对？”白发老头兀自一笑，淡淡道：“一名伪灵根少年能够拜入内门，这简直是青岚宗开天辟地头一次，你的事早就传遍青岚山了。”
“自己去那边挑选功法吧，小心点，别把书本给我弄乱了！”
老者语气带着不屑，说完便自顾自地看起了手中的书籍，不再理会林越。
林越并不在意，他径直走到角落，在重生记忆里，那部被所有人当成废物的残破功法，就丢在那里，没人在意！
他是在之后的重生过程中，偶然发现了这部功法的奥妙，如今提前找到，省去了不少麻烦。
《九转玄元功》！
林越在角落的书架底层，拿起那本纸张泛黄、字迹都快模糊了的古籍，吹去了铺在上面厚厚的灰尘。
“小伙子，眼光不行啊，这本破功法是百年前一位长老留下的，里面记载的内容乱七八糟，完全不能修炼，废书一本，你换一本吧！”白发老者瞥了一眼，嗤的笑了一声。
“不换了，就它吧！”林越心中狂喜，面上却不露声色。这本看似残破的功法，实则是上古传承的地阶上品功法，只是缺少关键的运转口诀，才被当成废品扔在墙角！
而他重生五十次解锁的“功法解析”特权，正好能补全这缺失的口诀！
【叮！检测到残缺上古功法《九转玄元功》，是否消耗重生次数（当前剩余247次）解锁功法解析？】
林越毫不犹豫：“是！”
【功法解析中……解析成功！已补全缺失口诀，优化灵气运转路线，当前功法等级：地阶上品，适配四系伪灵根，修炼速度提升300%，突破境界成功率提升50%！】
脑海中瞬间涌入完整的功法口诀和优化后的灵力运转路线，林越只觉茅塞顿开，之前修炼时的滞涩感一扫而空！

四系伪灵根在这部功法面前，不仅不再是劣势，反而能同时吸收四种灵气，修炼速度比天灵根还要快！
“你确定选这本？”白发老者愣了一下。
“嗯，是的。”林越将古籍揣进怀里。
白发老者见他执意要选，也懒得劝说，挥挥手道：“随便你，登记一下就能走了。”
走出藏经阁，李长老见他拿了一本残破古籍，忍不住皱起了眉头：“林越，你怎么选了这本破书啊？这功法没人能修炼，选其他任意一本书都比这个强。”
“多谢李长老关心，弟子觉得这部功法与我有缘，想来应该能修炼吧。”林越笑道。
李长老见他态度坚决，也不再多说，只道：“也罢，修仙之路，机缘各异，你好自为之。”
随后，李长老带林越来到内门弟子的洞府区域，这里每个洞府都灵气充沛，配有聚灵阵，林越的洞府在西侧，编号三十三号，虽不算最好，但比外门弟子的集体宿舍好上百倍。
“这就是你的洞府，每月初一可去内门执事处领取十块下品灵石、三枚炼气丹，还有日常生活用品。好好修炼吧，三个月后的外门弟子大比，你作为新进的内门弟子，也可自愿参加，若能在大比上夺冠，就有机会获得进入后山灵气泉眼修炼的资格，于修炼会有莫大好处。”李长老叮嘱道。
“弟子明白，多谢李长老。”
送走李长老，林越走进洞府，关上石门，脸上再也抑制不住狂喜之色。
他立即盘膝坐下，取出《九转玄元功》，按照解析后的口诀运转灵力。
轰！
洞府内的灵气瞬间疯狂涌向他，四种不同属性的灵气顺着全身经脉运转，畅通无阻，没有丝毫滞涩，反而还能相互滋养，修炼速度比前世修炼《青岚诀》快了足足三倍！
“太好了！有这部功法，用不了多久，我就能突破炼气六层、七层！”林越心中激动，双拳紧握，“三个月后的外门大比，灵气泉眼的资格，我势在必得！”
接下来，便是疯狂修炼，快速升级，在青岚宗站稳脚跟，然后，朝着更高的境界，更强的实力，发起冲击！

content_en:
Sutra Pavilion.
There are three floors in total, located on the top of the Zongmen Mountain. The first floor is for Huangjie Kung Fu, the second floor is for Xuanjie, and the third floor is for Earthly Steps. Only disciples above the inner sect can enter.
"Master Nephew Lin, the inner disciples can only choose one yellow-level mid-level exercise or two yellow-level low-level exercises on the first floor. I won't accompany you in. You can go in and choose by yourself!" After Elder Li finished speaking, he waited outside the pavilion.
Lin Yue nodded and walked in.
The person who manages the Sutra Pavilion is a white-haired old man. He glanced at Lin Yue curiously and said, "The new inner disciple? You must be Lin Yue with the fourth line of pseudo-spiritual roots in Qingyang City!"
"Junior, that's right." Lin Yue clasped his fists.
"You want to ask me why I know you, right?" The white-haired old man smiled to himself and said calmly: "It is the first time in the history of Qinglan Sect that a young man with pseudo-spiritual roots can enter the inner sect. Your story has already spread throughout Qinglan Mountain."
"Go over there and choose the exercises yourself. Be careful and don't mess up the books for me!"
The old man's tone was disdainful. After speaking, he looked at the book in his hand and ignored Lin Yue.
Lin Yue didn't care. He walked straight to the corner. In his rebirth memory, the broken technique that everyone regarded as waste was just thrown there. No one cared!
He accidentally discovered the secret of this technique during his subsequent rebirth. Now that he found it in advance, he saved a lot of trouble.
"Nine Transformations of Xuanyuan Gong"!
Lin Yue was at the bottom of the bookshelf in the corner, picked up the ancient book with yellowing paper and almost blurred handwriting, and blew away the thick dust on it.
"Young man, you have poor discernment. This bad Kung Fu book was left by an elder a hundred years ago. The contents recorded in it are messy and cannot be practiced at all. It is a useless book. You can change it to another one!" The white-haired old man glanced at it and sneered.
"If you don't want to change it, just let it be!" Lin Yue was ecstatic in his heart, but his expression remained calm. This seemingly broken exercise book is actually a high-grade earth-level exercise inherited from ancient times. It just lacks the key operation instructions, so it is thrown into the corner as waste!
And the "Exercise Analysis" privilege he unlocked after being reborn fifty times can just make up for this missing formula!
【bite! The incomplete ancient skill "Nine Revolutions of Xuanyuan Gong" has been detected. Should the number of rebirths (currently 247 remaining) be consumed to unlock the analysis of the skill? 】
Lin Yue said without hesitation: "Yes!"
[The technique is being analyzed...the analysis was successful! The missing formula has been completed, and the spiritual energy circulation route has been optimized. The current skill level is: high-grade earth level, adapted to the four series of pseudo-spiritual roots. The cultivation speed is increased by 300%, and the success rate of breakthrough realm is increased by 50%! 】
The complete exercise formulas and optimized spiritual energy circulation routes instantly flooded into his mind. Lin Yue felt enlightened, and the sluggishness he felt during previous training was gone!
The four-system pseudo-spiritual roots are not only no longer a disadvantage in front of this technique, but can absorb four kinds of spiritual energy at the same time, and the cultivation speed is even faster than the heavenly spiritual roots!
"Are you sure you want to choose this one?" The white-haired old man was stunned for a moment.
"Well, yes." Lin Yue put the ancient book in his arms.
Seeing that he insisted on choosing, the white-haired old man didn't bother to persuade him. He waved his hand and said, "Whatever you want, just register and leave."
After walking out of the Scripture Collection Pavilion, Elder Li saw that he had taken a broken ancient book and couldn't help but frowned: "Lin Yue, why did you choose this broken book? No one can practice this technique. Any other book would be better than this one."
"Thank you, Elder Li, for your concern. This disciple feels that this technique is destined to me, and I think I should be able to practice it." Lin Yue said with a smile.
Elder Li saw that he was resolute and said no more. He just said: "It doesn't matter, there are different opportunities for cultivating immortals. You can take care of yourself."
Later, Elder Li took Lin Yue to the cave area of the inner disciples. Each cave here was full of spiritual energy and equipped with a spirit gathering array. Lin Yue's cave was on the west side, numbered 33. Although it was not the best, it was hundreds of times better than the dormitories of the outer disciples.
"This is your caveOn the first day of every month, you can go to the inner gate deacon's office to receive ten low-grade spiritual stones, three Qi Refining Pills, and daily necessities. Practice well. In the outer disciple competition in three months, as a new inner disciple, you can also voluntarily participate. If you can win the competition, you will have the opportunity to enter the spiritual energy spring in the back mountain to practice, which will be of great benefit to your cultivation. "Elder Li warned.
"Disciple understands, thank you very much Elder Li. "
After seeing Elder Li off, Lin Yue walked into the cave, closed the stone door, and could no longer suppress the look of ecstasy on his face.
He immediately sat down cross-legged, took out the "Nine Revolutions of Xuanyuan Gong", and used his spiritual power according to the analyzed formula.
Boom!
The spiritual energy in the cave instantly rushed towards him crazily. Four types of spiritual energy with different attributes circulated along the meridians of the body, flowing smoothly without any stagnation. Instead, they could nourish each other. The cultivation speed was three times faster than the "Qinglan Jue" practiced in the previous life!
"Great! With this technique, it won’t take long for me to break through the sixth or seventh level of Qi refining! Lin Yue was excited and clenched his fists, "In the outer sect competition in three months, I will definitely win the qualification for the spiritual energy spring!" "
The next step is to practice crazily, quickly upgrade, gain a firm foothold in Qinglan Sect, and then launch an impact towards a higher realm and stronger strength!
